title: How did a woman who died on her sofa go unnoticed for 3 years?
description:
In January 2006, housing officials in North London discovered the skeletal remains of Joyce Carol Vincent, a 38-year-old woman who had died on her sofa nearly three years earlier. The television was still on, tuned to BBC1, and electricity bills had been automatically debited the entire time. Christmas presents from 2003 remained unopened on the floor.

Once a vivacious Londoner with many friends, Joyce had quietly withdrawn by 2003—moving without telling anyone, cutting contact with siblings. Despite friends searching for her and contacting police, no missing person report was filed. The coroner could not determine her cause of death, citing too much time passed and no evidence of foul play. Her death went unnoticed as systems from the housing association to utility companies continued operating normally.
